neighbours.label: 'independent(ly)' in statistical association language (independent predictor, independently associated)
fire: Smoking remained an independent risk factor for stroke in the model.
Age was the strongest independent predictor of recovery.
Low income was independently associated with poorer sleep.
Obesity emerged as an independent predictor of mortality.
Both factors were independently linked to higher blood pressure.
Education level was an independent predictor of voting behaviour.
Diabetes was independently associated with longer hospital stays.
Only tumour size remained an independent prognostic marker.
quiet: Smoking was linked to stroke in the simple model.
Age was the strongest predictor of recovery.
Low income was associated with poorer sleep.
Obesity emerged as a major predictor of mortality.
Both factors were linked to higher blood pressure.
Education level was a useful predictor of voting behaviour.
Diabetes was associated with longer hospital stays.
Only tumour size remained a useful prognostic marker.
